info.title: TracerAI API
info.description: Read-only AWS networking troubleshooting tools for the TracerAI Bedrock Agent.

post.summary: Diagnose why two VPCs cannot connect
post.description: Gathers read-only route table and security group configuration for a source and target VPC so the agent can reason about connectivity failures.

sourceVpcId.description: The source VPC ID, e.g. vpc-0abc123.

targetVpcId.description: The target VPC ID, e.g. vpc-0def456.

200.description: Route tables and security groups for both VPCs.
